summary: Firefox is moving Web Speech recognition to on-device processing, using locally downloaded Parakeet models selected for the user’s language instead of the old online-recognition path. Model installation is now integrated with `start()`, with permission prompts, download progress, refusal/failure reporting, availability checks, and AI Controls plus a permission policy to manage access. The Web Speech API is also being brought closer to the standard, exposing recognition timing, streaming confidence, multilingual results, and the `unspokenPunctuation` attribute, while improving cancellation, audio streaming, and process lifetime handling.
